confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Cafe, beer and restaurant anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given July demand. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine about 1.25x beer) since direct knowledge is weaker. USD values carry lari exchange-rate drift. FX value comes from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages, not a direct page read; one result still showed 13 Oct 2026 at 0.6961.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Regional basis is Caucasus and Eastern European capitals with similar price levels and tourist demand (for example Yerevan, Sofia, Belgrade). Region set to Europe for travel-price grouping although Georgia is transcontinental. Hostel and hotel anchors reflect July high-season demand.
